svg.metadata: {"story":"Moses","act":12,"chapter":"Ch.12 · The Spies and Rebellion","scene":"A","layer":"foreground","artDirection":"Twelve spies cross the land for forty days and return with a cluster of grapes on a pole; ten report giants and walled cities, Caleb and Joshua urge trust, and the people weep and refuse, so the generation is turned back to the wilderness. Stage: a border ridge at dusk, a grape cluster hanging from a carrying pole, twelve travel-worn men at a council fire, an assembly in tears, two men tearing their clothes; the promised land lit in the distance and the way closing behind.","materials":["assets/materials/egypt_mud_brick-stretcher.svg","assets/materials/desert_sand-dunes.svg","assets/materials/bulrush_basket-woven.svg","assets/materials/stone_tablets-hewn.svg"],"seed":1}
